description: A function that takes or returns another function, such as `map`, `filter` or a factory.
A function that keeps access to variables of the scope where it was created, e.g. `factor` in `multiplyBy(factor)`.
Callbacks may declare fewer parameters than provided, so callback types should not mark parameters optional.
Legacy Node.js style `(error, result) => void`, replaced by promises and `async`/`await`.
